method: incompressible SPH projection (Cummins & Rudman 1999; Shao & Lo 2003)
analytic: u(y)=g y (H-y)/(2 nu); u_max=g H^2/(8 nu); tau_wall=rho g H/2

divergence_periodic_sine.probe: u_x = 0.4 sin(2 pi x / L), exact div = 0.4 k cos(k x)

window_sensitivity.definitions: fraction = window length / run length, window = [(1-f) t_end, t_end]

wall_shear_near_wall.note: diagnostic only: the wall layer spans one particle spacing, so the fitted wall slope is biased low; not an acceptance criterion
